plan.title: Accepted Counter Offer in Master QCS

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ on the buyer’s Responses screen.
Ensure counter offers are enabled for RFQ rounds.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled for the prepared RFQ.
Navigate to the Master QCS comparison grid.
Verify the comparison grid includes a real vendor column for Vendor A.
Verify Vendor A’s displayed rate is the accepted counter-offer price of 85.
Verify the accepted counter offer is ranked first.
Verify Vendor A’s line amount and total are calculated correctly from the displayed rate and quantity.
